name: W3C Agentic Web Working Group (draft charter)
status: Draft charter for a proposed Working Group, in charter refinement: the announcement on public-new-work gave approx. 2026-11-10 as the end of refinement (W3C Team estimate), and the Strategy issue #576, open on 2026-10-23 with the label "In Charter Refinement" and 4 comments, reads "Expected end of charter refinement phase: unknown". The charter file was last changed on 2026-10-13 by two editorial pull requests (#888 and #887); the last change to its scope is the commit of 2026-09-30 (a definition of the term and a simplified scope). According to the minutes of the AI Agent Protocol Community Group meeting of 2026-10-21, the Working Group had not been established on that day. A discussion of the charter was proposed for TPAC breakout #22 on 2026-10-30 (w3c-tpac-2026).
relevance: The draft charter proposes a Working Group "to develop specifications that facilitate web pages and applications to be leveraged by LLMs and AI agents", scoped to site capabilities and context for agents, agent identity and delegation, and permissions and policies for agent actions. Its one normative deliverable is WebMCP, adopted from the Web Machine Learning Community Group; it lists the Web Payment Security Interest Group (IG), IETF webbotauth and IETF aipref for coordination. On 2026-08-13 a representative of Apple wrote on PR #829 "Expect a formal objection if this is merged.", about the earlier plan to place WebMCP in the Web Machine Learning Working Group (WG). Charter-drafts PR #888 (editorial fixes, opened by the author of this map on 2026-10-02) was merged on 2026-10-13 at 11:06 UTC by one of its reviewers, after approvals by three reviewers: a participant on 2026-10-08 with the review text "LGTM" (review 5463458958) and two on 2026-10-13 (GitHub, read on 2026-10-14).

committed_next.what: Charter refinement until approximately 10 November 2026; notices of extension on the Strategy issue

boundary: Out of scope: model APIs, inference and execution; cryptographic authentication primitives; crawler controls; agent to server communications.
participation: The author of this map took part in charter-drafts PR #888 (editorial fixes to the draft, no change to scope; merged on 2026-10-13); see Disclosure.
